scope: Bounded reconciliation of saved182 identity decisions (30 prior+52 Principles/Physical+50 Inorganic+50 Organic), three written banks (13+14+32), and selected existing notes.
conclusion: Remaining work is principally explicit evidence mapping and representation decisions, plus bounded unfamiliar transfer and selected studied Physical/NO examples. Existing authored chapter completion and59 bank entries do not certify1.25. No claim of exhaustive reaction variants or teaching certification.

items.obligation: Compulsory cross-topic skill; no compulsory reagent pair
items.assessment: General lesson has a supplied Al/O2 balance and a subscript question, not a complete names-to-word/formula/state transfer task. New bank practices supply identities within taught families and provide useful transfer, but do not alone demonstrate broad unfamiliar supplied-information handling.
items.nextAction: Add a bounded genuinely unfamiliar supplied-identity task with formulas or sufficient charge information and explicit phases; ask word and balanced state-labelled equations. Do not require invented product prediction or infinite variants.

items.obligation: General representative choices, not prescribed Haber/Contact/HI synthesis cases
items.assessment: Existing studied equations include N2/H2/NH3, H2/Cl2/HCl, H2/I2/HI, CaCO3/CaO/CO2, SO2/O2/SO3. Balanced equations and interpretation tasks already exist, but these are absent from the three finite banks and generally lack paired word-equation production evidence.
items.nextAction: Reconcile existing cases into collection evidence with word names and contextual states; reuse existing teaching. Do not invent industrial catalysts/conditions as compulsory demands. Distinguish supplied gas-phase bond model and equilibrium conditions.

items.obligation: Dissolving method class required under3.2;3.8 says SOME practicals; salt identity optional
items.assessment: Ammonium nitrate dissolving is an actual fixed practice with calorimetry, but no written dissolution representation or explicit physical-versus-reaction collection disposition. The other three calorimetry classes have bank examples.
items.nextAction: Record dissolution explicitly as physical solvation/dissociation, optionally NH4NO3(s) → NH4+(aq)+NO3−(aq), with conservation and states; do not count it as a new synthesis or require four performed trials.

items.obligation: Iron rusting named; iron oxygen-removal example; zinc galvanising specified
items.assessment: Correct water/oxygen and variable-hydration teaching exists; banks omit rust. No fixed Fe/O2/H2O molecular balance is warranted. Sacrificial zinc half-equation already exists.
items.nextAction: Add a collection disposition/word model iron + oxygen + water → hydrated iron(III) oxide, explaining variable composition prevents one unique hydrated formula. Link existing zinc electron equation; barriers are not separate chemical reactions.

items.obligation: Four named repeat structures compulsory; no fixed industrial conditions
items.assessment: All four repeats and displayed drawing tasks already exist, including continuation bonds and n. Finite model banks intentionally defer them. This is a collection representation/linkage gap, not missing repeat teaching.
items.nextAction: Link or add structure-aware monomer→polymer equations for ethene, propene, chloroethene, tetrafluoroethene alongside existing diagrams. Do not validate open repeats as closed molecules or infer depolymerisation chemistry from reverse drawing.

items.obligation: Diacid/diol family and named ethanedioic acid/ethanediol structure compulsory; Paper2C
items.assessment: Named monomers, displayed repeat, C4H4O4,2n versus2n−1 water distinction are already taught. Finite banks defer structural equation representation.
items.nextAction: Integrate existing structure evidence with explicit word/structural equation and repeat-aware accounting. Preserve ideal2n-water shorthand versus one finite open chain; no invented universal state/catalyst conditions.

items.obligation: Engine nitrogen-oxide context and sulfur-impurity oxidation required; exact oxide sequence representative
items.assessment: Engine N2/O2 origin is explained but lacks a chosen balanced formula model. Sulfur S+O2→SO2 already appears and can reuse Inorganic sulfur-combustion, qualified as elemental illustration. Acid-rain explanation does not prescribe a unique complete equation.
items.nextAction: Add/reconcile one justified N2(g)+O2(g)→2NO(g) initial-oxide example with high-temperature condition and word names. Do not claim NO is all exhaust or elemental sulfur every impurity; explicitly disposition acid-rain as explanation without one universal mechanism.

items.obligation: Named dichromate oxidation route compulsory; current representation incomplete for full-reagent claims
items.assessment: [O] model correctly disclaims full reagent balance and has no state-symbol evidence. Its presence cannot silently certify every full-formula demand under1.25.
items.nextAction: Root must explicitly decide adequacy of syllabus-appropriate shorthand and retain limitation, or independently validate an actual ionic/molecular reagent equation if needed. No need to invent mechanistic or aldehyde isolation obligations.

items.obligation: Li/Na/K air comparison compulsory; calcium/cold-water and particular acid pairs representative
items.assessment: Air tarnishing and multiple products correctly qualified; no unique simple oxide equation. Calcium-water is studied in prose but not in current banks. Mg steam and Group1 cold-water cases already covered.
items.nextAction: Disposition air comparison as no uniquely specified product equation; do not fabricate all M2O. Consider one supplied calcium hydroxide phase-context equation only to cover the actually studied additional example, not a required full metal-by-reagent matrix.

items.obligation: Physical changes and bonding explanations, not separately prescribed reactions
items.assessment: Saved30 early decisions correctly exclude state changes/mixture separation from mandatory new reaction enumeration.
items.nextAction: Keep state-change/unchanged-substance distinctions and do not manufacture decomposition equations for melting, boiling, dissolution or separation.

items.assessment: Core banks already cover MgO/CuO, hydrated-salt change and four named electrolysis contexts; Inorganic hydrogen combustion supports water composition. Existing half-equation teaching must remain linked rather than replaced by overall balances.
